The asphalt diffuse texture is adapted from Asphalt 04 by Sergej Majboroda and Jenelle van Heerden, Poly Haven, CC0. https://polyhaven.com/a/asphalt_04

The sky panorama is resized from Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky) by Greg Zaal and Jarod Guest, Poly Haven, CC0. https://polyhaven.com/a/kloofendal_48d_partly_cloudy_puresky

Family Sedan v1 LOD1 by tevy, CC0 1.0. Geometry grouped by material, scaled for the lesson and repainted. https://tevy.dev/models/family-sedan

Traffic models from tevy, CC0 1.0, version 1. Assets converted to baseline glTF with JPEG maps, transparent windows, varied paints and posed helmeted riders for this game.
https://tevy.dev/models/hatchback
https://tevy.dev/models/kei-van
https://tevy.dev/models/motor-scooter
https://tevy.dev/models/casual-walker
https://tevy.dev/models/hiker
https://tevy.dev/models/road-worker

GLTFLoader and SkeletonUtils are from three.js r160, MIT. The license is in ../THREE-LICENSE.txt.

Leafy Grass by Charlotte Baglioni and Brown Mud by Rob Tuytel, Poly Haven, CC0. The diffuse maps were converted to WebP for the roadside grass and earth.
https://polyhaven.com/a/leafy_grass
https://polyhaven.com/a/brown_mud

The roadside rain tree and coconut palm are original AI-generated cutout assets, exported as transparent WebP images for the game.
